review_scope: Host-only inspection of frozen standalone probe, proposal, fixture, branch histories, source pins and recorded outputs. Ran only --validate-only --mock-tests; no HF/TT inference, model imports, or device access.
host_validation_summary: Passed case/branch validation, pure host summary tests, forced-history callback mock, cleanup-error preservation and saved-logit comparison mock; output confirms torch, Transformers and TTNN not imported.

findings.impact: The proposal describes this as a full escape contrast / one of two observed continuations, but it forces a synthetic 147 at index 5 where the matched full seed42 output emitted 556. Rows through index5 still score the same prefix, but row6 is conditioned on the wrong token and its expected-token annotation is not the recorded full continuation.
findings.proposed_correction: If the intent is to capture the observed full seed42 continuation, use [1390,107,147,1390,107,556] and update the exact branch validator and branch/source pins. If the repeated-147 counterfactual is desired as a separate hypothesis, keep it under a clearly counterfactual name and include the exact full seed42 branch separately.

evidence.probe_summary_behavior: analyze_logits selects exactly20 candidates with score-descending/global-ID-ascending tie break, normalizes their host FP32 logits, then reconstructs nominal .95 or BF16 .94921875 nucleus distributions over that set.
evidence.pinned_hf_warper_behavior: Installed pinned Transformers TopKLogitsWarper masks scores strictly below the kth score, so all kth-score ties survive and support can exceed20; TopPLogitsWarper then applies its own sorted-logit mask.
evidence.device_behavior_limit: The probe reads TT full-vocabulary logits but does not record TT top32 candidate indices, device k/p filtered support, probability quantization or sampled draw.

findings.impact: The fields `top_k20_distribution` and `top_p095_*_distribution` can look like engine distributions although they are deterministic host reconstructions. The report does label them estimates and says it does not model device probability quantization; nevertheless HF tie-expanded support is not reproduced, and none of the TT sampler support is observed.
findings.proposed_correction: Retain raw logits/ranks as primary evidence. Label the outputs explicitly as host strict-20 tie-break proxies and state that neither HF processor support nor TT device support is exact. If a support/probability claim is needed, pass captured logits through the pinned HF Temperature/TopK/TopP processor stack, and separately capture the device candidate IDs and post-k/p probabilities or validate against the actual device sampler implementation. Do not infer canonical support from these reconstructed fields.
